verdicts.title: Characterizing Tseitin-formulas with short regular resolution refutations
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Tseitin-formulas are systems of parity constraints whose structure is described by a graph. These formulas have been studied extensively in proof complexity as hard instances in many proof systems. In this paper, we prove that a class of unsatisfiable Tseitin-formulas of bounded degree has regular resolution refutations of polynomial length if and only if the treewidth of all underlying graphs $G$ for that class is in $O(\log|V(G)|)$. While both relate graph parameters to resolution length on Tseitin formulas, the abstract makes no claim about Cheeger/expansion, so it neither confirms nor refutes the specific h(G) bound.

verdicts.title: Cheeger inequalities for graph limits
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce notions of Cheeger constants for graphons and graphings. We prove Cheeger and Buser inequalities for these. On the way we prove co-area formulae for graphons and graphings.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Cheeger and Buser inequalities for graphons and graphings (graph limits), with no mention of Tseitin formulas, resolution refutation length, or proof complexity. It shares only the 'Cheeger constant' vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Refutability as Recursive as Provability
